tenderSchedule.title: ABC and ARV Programme in TMC Moodubidire
tenderSchedule.description: Implementation of Animal Birth Control (ABC) / Anti Rabies Vaccination (ARV) Programme in TMC Moodubidire for the year 2026-27

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

Animal Welfare Organizations, Non-Government Organizations, Registered or Partnership Firms, Public Limited, Resident Welfare Associations, Institutions, and Individuals who have registered with the Animal welfare Board of India are eligible to participate
Tenderer must adhere to the scope of work as per the tender document
Tender Inviting authority has the right to accept/reject all or any of the tenders
Tenderer should adhere to all the conditions in this tender document

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Aadhaar Number, PAN Number, Bank Account details and GST Number Certificates if applicable
Copy of Annual Turnover Certificate of Rs.10.00 lakhs, Income tax paid certificate of previous 3 years
Documents proving Bidders having required land, kennel facilities, animal operation theatres, post operative care, dog catching van, and dog catchers and others
Documents showing Details of arrangement of feeding the dogs while they are pounded and details of water and electricity facilities proposed.
Documents showing Experience of the applicant in animal welfare and animal related activities certified from Urban Local Bodies
Registration Certificate with the Animal Welfare Board of India
Upload duly filled and signed copies of Appendix B and Appendix C of tender document

itemList.itemName: Sterilization, Anti-rabies Vaccine & De-worming including, catching, post-operative care, releasing, destruction of operation extracted parts and tissues, etc., complete of Female dogs
